basis: RPG Maker event pages decoded with liblcf; normal starting-room route, not general event-condition evaluation.

sources.events: Event 3 at (7,5) requires facing left; sleeping passes through map 900 and finishes at map 5 (9,12). Event 5 at (9,4) normally leads to balcony map 3; its other destinations belong to conditional endings.
Event 7 at (9,15) is a touch event leading to dream bedroom map 4 (9,5).
Event 8 at (15,7) requires facing right. Normal destination is Nexus map 10 (3,4); conditional pages can instead enter puzzle map 2653.

limitations: The source graph remains a collection of candidates: unrelated event conditions are not evaluated.
Map 2653 is a conditional puzzle destination and its puzzle is not solved by this overlay.
Ending maps 222, 223, 224, 225 and 448 are not alternative Nexus maps. Their former direct Nexus edges were fabricated by the scraper.
The reviewed source hashes identify the map versions used to derive these corrections; the overlay does not claim compatibility with future map revisions.
